why: the handle's representation, ownership and origin are declared

ownership.receiver: the handle by value (a Copy handle: copied, never consumed)
ownership.host: a read loan for the call, not retained

resolve.allocation: the result text; the failure value with its `host` field when the host is not localhost
resolve.cancellation: not a cancellation point: the operation completes; a cancellation of the task is observed at its next await (12.4)
